source: ALM Arbor Lodging overview + regional experience materials (June 2026); CALA third-party growth positioning

commercialFields.bf_operating_situations:
Third-party management for franchised Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG assets in Mexico and emerging CALA markets
Conversion, reflag, and repositioning assignments where brand technical services and operating reset create value
Resort and leisure-oriented product in Mexico gateway and destination markets (e.g., Baja, coastal leisure corridors)
Urban select-service and lifestyle hotels with meaningful commercial and owner-reporting complexity
Owner-aligned transitions with explicit milestones from selection through stabilization
commercialFields.bf_not_ideal_for:
Passive owner mandates with no governance appetite or reporting discipline
Unfunded PIP, renovation, or brand-obligations scope
Ultra-luxury standalone assets outside Arbor's select-service, lifestyle, and resort operating strengths
Single rural independent assets with no path to brand distribution or operating scale
Exploratory inquiries without decision authority, data access, or realistic transition timeline
commercialFields.bf_selected_asset_types: Mid-Rise, Resort-Style Compound, Historic / Renovated, Mixed-Use
commercialFields.bf_selected_situation_types: Fully Entitled, Under Construction, Stabilized Operating Asset
commercialFields.bf_selected_deal_structures: Third-Party Management (Franchised Brand), Third-Party Management (Independent / Soft Brand)
commercialFields.bf_fit_criteria_json: [{"fitCriteria":"Market Fit","operatorLooksFor":"Mexico-first CALA execution with credible gateway and leisure demand—Mexico City hub, Baja/coastal leisure corridors, and relationship-led expansion across Caribbean and Latin America.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Asset Type Fit","operatorLooksFor":"Select-service, lifestyle, full-service resort, soft-brand, independent, and conversion/reflag assets where Arbor's renovation and repositioning experience applies.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Ownership Fit","operatorLooksFor":"Owners seeking a vertically integrated partner with investment discipline, transparent reporting, and active regional leadership from Mexico City.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Brand / Flag Fit","operatorLooksFor":"Projects aligned with Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, or IHG requirements—or credible independent/soft-brand positioning with realistic PIP and onboarding path.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Operating Complexity","operatorLooksFor":"Transitions, renovations, F&B-heavy resort or lifestyle product, and multi-stakeholder owner situations where integrated BD, ops, and commercial teams add value.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Commercial Upside","operatorLooksFor":"Assets with revenue-management, distribution, direct-booking, or repositioning upside supported by integrated sales and revenue leadership.","importance":"High"},{"fitCriteria":"Capital / CapEx Readiness","operatorLooksFor":"Owners with realistic renovation, PIP, or pre-opening capital plans and willingness to fund brand and operating requirements.","importance":"Medium / High"},{"fitCriteria":"Timing & Readiness","operatorLooksFor":"Defined management-selection or transition trigger, accessible operating data, and authority to execute within 60–120 days.","importance":"High"}]
commercialFields.bf_best_fit_project_types_json: [{"fitLevel":"Best Fit","projectType":"Third-Party Management (Franchised)","ownerContext":"Approved-brand assets in Mexico and CALA where owners want Mexico City–based execution with U.S. platform depth."},{"fitLevel":"Best Fit","projectType":"Conversion / Reflag","ownerContext":"Existing hotels moving between flags, soft brands, or independent positioning with renovation and operating reset needs."},{"fitLevel":"Best Fit","projectType":"Resort / Leisure (Mexico)","ownerContext":"Coastal, destination, or F&B-oriented leisure assets aligned with Arbor's repositioning and resort operating playbooks."},{"fitLevel":"Selective Fit","projectType":"Urban Gateway Select-Service","ownerContext":"Mexico City and major urban gateways when brand path, labor model, and owner reporting needs are clear."},{"fitLevel":"Selective Fit","projectType":"New Build / Pre-Opening","ownerContext":"Best when capital stack, brand approval, and opening timeline are confirmed with owner alignment on pre-opening support."},{"fitLevel":"Limited Fit","projectType":"Ultra-Luxury Standalone","ownerContext":"May not leverage Arbor's core strengths in select-service, lifestyle, and conversion-oriented operating model."}]
commercialFields.bf_preferred_deal_profile_json: [{"label":"Preferred Owner Type","value":"Developers, family offices, institutional holders, and owners seeking hands-on third-party management with regional accountability."},{"label":"Preferred Agreement Type","value":"Third-party management (franchised or independent/soft brand), transition management, and pre-opening support; equity co-investment selectively via Arbor Lodging Partners."},{"label":"Preferred Market Position","value":"Upper-midscale through upscale select-service, lifestyle, soft-brand collections, and resort-oriented product in Mexico and CALA."},{"label":"Ideal Situation","value":"Owner has defined objectives, brand direction, accessible financials, funded capex/PIP awareness, and a 60–120 day decision path."},{"label":"Less Ideal Situation","value":"Exploratory process without authority, unfunded brand obligations, or passive owner expecting low-touch management."},{"label":"Important Deal Signals","value":"Responsiveness, data quality, brand approval status, capex readiness, transition urgency, and alignment on governance cadence."}]
commercialFields.bf_evaluation_path_json: [{"title":"Initial Screen","description":"Review market, asset type, keys, brand status, ownership profile, and transition or opening timing."},{"title":"CALA Fit Qualification","description":"Assess Mexico City regional resourcing, brand approval fit, and complexity match against Arbor CALA operating model."},{"title":"Information Request","description":"Collect trailing financials, STR/comp-set context, PIP/capex plan, labor outlook, and owner priority memo."},{"title":"Internal Review","description":"Operations, commercial, finance, and leadership review feasibility, transition staffing, and brand obligations."},{"title":"Owner Discussion","description":"Align on reporting cadence, governance, fees, brand path, and transition milestones with regional leadership."},{"title":"Proposal Path","description":"Issue management proposal, transition plan, or defer with documented rationale if fit is insufficient."}]
commercialFields.bf_red_flags_json: [{"title":"Unclear Ownership Authority","description":"Decision-maker not identified or investor group not aligned on management path."},{"title":"Insufficient CapEx / PIP Funding","description":"Renovation, life-safety, or brand requirements lack realistic funding or schedule."},{"title":"Unrealistic Performance Expectations","description":"Owner underwriting ignores market, brand standards, or operating economics in Mexico/CALA context."},{"title":"No Transition or Opening Trigger","description":"Perpetual exploratory phase without financing, brand approval, or operating handover need."},{"title":"Poor Strategic Fit","description":"Asset type or market outside Arbor's Mexico-first CALA and conversion-oriented strengths."},{"title":"Limited Data Access","description":"Inability to review financials, contracts, or operating history before proposal."}]
